title: View and Add New Tasks
user_story: As a user, I want to see an input field and a list area on the page, so that I can quickly add new items to my to-do list.
acceptance_criteria: The page loads with a text input box and an Add button visible at the top.
Typing text into the input and clicking Add or pressing Enter creates a new task item in the list below.
The input field clears automatically after successfully adding a task.
Submitting an empty input does not create a blank task.
